text:
Mikhail Petrov  
Email: mikhail.petrov@healthtechinnovations.com | Phone: (555) 123-4567 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/mikhailpetrov | GitHub: github.com/mikhailpetrov  

A seasoned DevOps/SRE Engineer with 15 years of experience in healthcare technology, specializing in scalable infrastructure, cloud-native systems, and mission-critical reliability. My career has been defined by bridging the gap between clinical needs and technical execution, with a focus on automation, cost efficiency, and operational excellence. Over the past decade, I’ve led teams through complex migrations, designed architectures for global telemedicine platforms, and optimized cloud environments to support AI-driven diagnostics. My work emphasizes measurable outcomes, with a track record of reducing infrastructure costs, improving system uptime, and enabling seamless integration between legacy systems and modern cloud services.  

**Technical Skills**  
Linux system administration, Python scripting, CI/CD pipeline design, cloud cost optimization, cloud migration strategy, Docker containerization, monitoring and alerting frameworks, AWS architecture, Kubernetes orchestration, Terraform infrastructure as code.  

**Professional Experience**  
At HealthTech Innovations Inc., I oversee a multi-cloud infrastructure supporting AI-driven diagnostics, where I reduced annual cloud costs by 22% through resource optimization and automation. This involved redesigning auto-scaling policies, implementing custom metrics dashboards, and integrating cost alerts into existing monitoring workflows. My team also adopted Kubernetes for workload management, which improved deployment consistency and reduced incident resolution times by 18%. Prior to this, I led the migration of MedTech Solutions’ legacy systems to AWS, where I designed CI/CD pipelines for medical device firmware updates, ensuring zero downtime during the transition. The project involved automating testing for regulatory compliance and deploying scalable microservices that handled over 10 million patient records monthly.  

In my role as Senior SRE at HealthGuard Analytics, I architected global monitoring systems for telemedicine platforms, achieving 99.95% SLA compliance. This required integrating Prometheus with custom dashboards, setting up alerting rules for critical metrics, and implementing load balancing across regional clusters. I also contributed to the development of Python-based scripts that automated routine system checks, reducing manual overhead by 30%. My work on load balancing ensured consistent performance during peak usage, which was critical for real-time video consultations.  

Earlier in my career, as a Systems Administrator at Regional Healthcare Clinic, I managed on-premises infrastructure for hospital IT systems, including Linux servers and network devices. This role laid the foundation for my expertise in automation and reliability, as I implemented scripts to streamline backup processes and reduce administrative errors.  

**Projects**  
- Redesigned cloud cost management for HealthTech Innovations Inc., achieving a 22% annual reduction through automated tagging, reserved instance purchases, and resource utilization analytics.  
- Developed CI/CD pipelines for firmware updates at MedTech Solutions, ensuring compliance with FDA regulations and reducing deployment cycles from weeks to hours.  
- Built a global monitoring system for HealthGuard Analytics, integrating Prometheus, Grafana, and custom alerts to maintain 99.95% SLA compliance across 12 regions.  
- Implemented Kubernetes at HealthTech Innovations Inc., improving deployment consistency and reducing incident resolution times by 18% through automated rollbacks and health checks.  

**Education**  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Moscow State University, 2009.  

**Certifications**  
AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Terraform Associate.
